title: Hauler 路线缓存与 CPU 优化
summary: CPU investigation identified repeated Hauler route feasibility checks and short local path reuse as optimization targets; user requested route/port caching and reusePath extension, while deferring empty-pickup waiting.

findings.title: Hauler route feasibility was recomputed repeatedly
findings.detail: At the observed tick, creeps used 9.4459 CPU/tick and Hauler role used 4.5739. W23N26 contributed 7.0892 CPU/tick with 10 Haulers. Existing movement reused engine paths for 15 ticks, but logistics route feasibility and delivery-port searches remained repeated on new assignments and blocked ports.
evidence: Observed CPU window: mean 16.4973, max 22.8805, bucket 36.
Independent review found repeated findPathTo calls in logistics route assignment; movement already used engine reusePath.

findings.title: Empty-pickup waiting remains deferred
findings.detail: The user explicitly deferred empty-pickup waiting and backoff, so no idle wait state was added in this change.
evidence: Scope decision from the current task.

tasks.title: Add bounded static Hauler route cache
tasks.progress: Implemented heap-only source-to-destination route caching with TTL and size bounds, plus per-task routeKey.
tasks.next: Verify fresh live CPU window after deployment.

tasks.title: Retain delivery-port cache during contention
tasks.progress: Implemented short port lease retention with hit, wait and miss counters.

tasks.title: Extend local movement path reuse
tasks.progress: Raised stable local move reusePath from 15 to 50 ticks while retaining per-tick moveTo calls.
tasks.next: Observe path search and blocked-step counters.

tasks.title: Keep empty-pickup waiting unchanged
tasks.progress: No empty-pickup waiting/backoff logic was added, per user instruction.
tasks.next: Revisit only if live CPU remains high after route caching.
